biotools.summary: The Sweat Rate Calculator is a tool that predicts whole body sweat rate during indoor treadmill and cycle ergometer exercise, based on power output and environmental conditions. It utilizes equations developed and validated in a peer-reviewed publication, allowing for individualized hydration management during physical training and exercise physiology experiments.
biotools.name: Sweat Rate Calculator
